• 2026-11-16

    Hacked target: Lighter

    Description of the event: On November 16, 2026, Lighter (a perpetual futures DEX on an Ethereum ZK rollup) suffered an incident due to a leaked trader API key (caused by unsafe non-official SDK signing code that reused nonces, allowing private key recovery from public signatures). The attacker used the keys to create public pools and drain funds, with ~$10.39M USDC withdrawn (estimates up to ~$15.5M). Protocol and smart contracts were unaffected; the team paused withdrawals, enabled Guardian mode, recovered ~$5M, and resumed operations.

    Amount of loss: $ 10,393,057 Attack method: API key leakage

  • 2026-11-12

    Hacked target: Coinone (MetaM)

    Description of the event: On November 12, 2026, the server of Coinone’s outsourced customer support provider (MetaM) was illegally accessed by external attackers, resulting in the potential leak of personal information from users who had contacted the customer center. Exposed data may include names, phone numbers, emails, dates of birth, bank account numbers, passwords, resident registration numbers, ID issue dates, home addresses, wallet addresses, and TXIDs (varying by individual). Coinone’s core membership, trading, and wallet systems remain unaffected. The exchange blocked related IPs, reported the incident to authorities, and is investigating with the contractor.

    Amount of loss: 0 Attack method: Supply Chain Attack
